scripts.verify:ci: npm run repo:check && npm run docs:check && npm run docs:api:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run test:platform
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run check --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test tests/*.test.mjs apps/marketing/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.dev:marketing: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@gen-z/marketing
scripts.dev:platform: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@gen-z/platform
scripts.build:platform: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@gen-z/platform
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@gen-z/operations
